answer: One concrete Sybil defense is pairwise collusion screening of graders. If several new accounts always score each other's answers identically, the ledger flags the cluster and voids their grades, so the ripple of fake agreement never reaches payouts. An attacker must fund separate stakes, separate compute and genuinely divergent work for every identity; a sable mask of a hundred puppets costs a hundred honest efforts, and the lotus of real reputation only blooms on independent history.
